field.label: Source
field.help: manual: servers added by hand. subscription: servers imported from a URL; Refresh re-fetches them.

field.label: Subscription URL
field.help: Subscription URL. Used by Refresh. Only a base64 or plain-text list of vless:// links is supported.

field.label: Subscription User-Agent
field.help: User-Agent sent when fetching the subscription.
field.hint: Default: v2rayNG/1.9.5 — panels return different formats per User-Agent

field.label: Last Fetch
field.help: Timestamp of the last successful fetch. Maintained automatically.

field.label: Last Node Count
field.help: Number of nodes seen in the last fetch. Maintained automatically.
